233	   233	- Commit only the paths that you name. Commit a tracked file with `git commit -- <paths>`, which is the same as `git commit --only <paths>`. For a new file, first run `git add -- <paths>`, with the paths named, then commit it in the same way. Never use `git add -A`, `git add .` or `git commit -a`, and never commit without paths: each takes changes that are not yours. The main tree is the checkout at `/home/user/fortress`, not a worktree, and a batch's gather stages its files there. While a batch runs, edit nothing tracked there (`references/batch.md`, "While it runs").
234	   234	- Push after every commit, in the order of `fortress-repo`'s committing part.
235	   235	
236	   236	## The boot
237	   237	
238	   238	At session start and after each compaction, take these steps in order:
239	   239	
240	   240	0. Check the serving model: run `explorations/coordinator/tools/model-now.sh`, which prints the model of this turn's reply. If it prints nothing, use the `get_session` tool with no session ID: its `session_context.model` and `external_metadata.last_served_model`. If the model is neither Opus nor Fable, act as on the model check's alarm (below). Then check the transcript backup (below).
241	   241	1. `FACTS.md`, `POSITIONS.md` and `INDEX.md`, each whole. Read `FACTS.md` in pages: it is larger than one page of the Read tool.
242	   242	2. Run `explorations/coordinator/check-index.sh`. Add an INDEX line for each note that it reports.
243	   243	3. `PLAN.md`, its first section.
244	   244	4. The boot note, then the held list.
245	   245	5. `git log --oneline -15`, for a worker's commit newer than the boot note.

247	   247	7. Load `references/delegating.md`, so that you give the work to workers and do not slip into doing it yourself.
248	   248	8. 249	   249	
250	   250	**A light boot.** When the curator asks for a light boot, take steps 0 and 3 to 8, and skip steps 1 and 2: FACTS, POSITIONS and INDEX stay unread. 251	   251	
252	   252	**The transcript backup.** Check it right after step 0 at every boot, a light boot included, and after every VM restart, since the backup fails with no message:
253	   253	
254	   254	- If the backup's worktree, `/home/user/fortress-transcripts-blinded`, is missing or not on its branch `transcripts-blinded`, re-arm the backup before the rest of the boot (the `cloud-container` skill, `references/container-loss.md`, "Re-arming the backup").

265	   265	  - do no other work until step 0's check shows Opus or Fable again, or the curator says to go on.
266	   266

268	   268	
269	   269	## The parts
270	   270	
271	   271	- `references/delegating.md`: before you brief, launch, watch or resume any worker.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""skills-lint.py [FILE...]: find the coordinator's agenda in the project skills.

The patterns and their scopes are the "Lint pattern list" of
explorations/reviews/skills-agenda-audit.md:

  fortress-repo and cloud-container, SKILL.md and parts: every set but sources;
  coordinator, SKILL.md and parts: handles (coordinator form), status, stale;
  every references/sources.md: the sources set only.

A file's skill is the folder after "skills/" in its path, so a copy made with
`git show REV:.claude/skills/...` into a folder of the same layout is linted
as the file it copies. A skill not named above takes every set.

With no FILE, every file under the repository's .claude/skills/. Prints
`path:line: set: text` for each hit, the text clipped around the match, and
exits 1 if there is any. Patterns are case-insensitive unless they say (?-i:...).
ALLOW lists hits read and passed, by file, set and a substring of the line.
"""
import os, re, sys

HANDLES = [
    r"\bQ\d+(\.\d+)?\b",
    r"\bitems? (1\d|[2-9]\d|\d{3})[a-z]?\b",
    r"\b(climb )?batch(es)? \d+('s)?\b",
    r"\brung (?!-)[A-Z]\b|\brung's\b",
    r"\b(review|gather|coldread|delta-unfolded|review-routed|judge-review)\.\d+\b",
]
HANDLES_COORDINATOR = HANDLES[:3] + [r"\brung (?!-)[A-Z]\b"]
STATUS = [
    r"\b(pending|unanswered|not (yet )?answered|has not answered|awaiting|still open|leaves the question|to be applied)\b",
    r"\bdoes not yet say\b|\b(is|are) not yet (decided|known|answered)\b",
    r"\bthe default of (Q\d|item \d|way)|\bat (its|the) default\b|\bway \d+[a-z]?\b",
]
PROVENANCE = [
    r"\bcurator('s)? (decided|kept|chose|ruled|answered)\b",
    r"\bthe curator (gives|weighs|keeps)\b",
    r"\bcurator's (answer|decision|ruling|choice)\b",
    r"\bis a decision of the curator\b",
    r"\b(his|her) (answer|decision|word|go|review|choice)\b",
coordinator

content.content:
## The method

1. Draft the outline first, with a home for every rule that moves.
2. Have the writer write each part whole, by the seven principles of `explorations/reviews/skills-writing-principles.md`. A rewrite is never longer than the text that it replaces.
3. Run a cold read. Review its flags, and have the writer fix them. Only then have a worker put a change that waits for the curator's yes on the page of skill drafts (step 4).

4. Land a change that waits for no yes after its cold read. Put a change that waits for the curator's yes, whichever skill it touches, under "Proposed changes" on the page of skill drafts, as one item with its new text whole. `SKILL.md`, "The curator's role and decisions", says which changes wait.

5. Brief each comment of the curator to the writer, rather than rewrite it yourself. A comment marks a problem area: the writer fixes its paragraph or section, with the whole skill in mind.
6. Settle the writer's minor decisions from the record. On the other skills, a change waits for the curator's yes only where a rule would change its meaning or a new rule would enter: it goes under "Proposed changes" on the page of skill drafts (step 4). On the coordinator skill, `SKILL.md`, "The curator's role and decisions", says what waits.

7. After each change to the coordinator skill or to `fortress-repo` lands, have a worker update that skill's page: the page of skill drafts for the coordinator skill, the page of `fortress-repo` changes for `fortress-repo`. The boot note holds both links. Give the worker the page's URL, and have it publish by that URL. The record-landing workflow runs this update itself for the changes to `fortress-repo` that follow a landing (`references/batch.md`, "The landing", step 4).
